layers.baseline: Official structural and outcome data; annual or quarterly; guarantees comparable coverage.
layers.flow: Weekly visibility, response and action signals from news, search and platform metadata.
layers.issue: Event heat, verification, response latency, correction reach and recovery.

model.missing_data: Never replace missing observations with zero. Carry forward official baselines within their validity period; publish confidence and coverage separately.
model.normalization: Winsorized percentile within a declared peer cohort, then 0-100 scaling.
model.rumor_rule: Unverified community claims affect Issue Heat and stability only. They do not directly reduce R or E until corroborated and reviewed.
